invariants.name: Intent Confidence Bounded in [0.0, 1.0]
invariants.description: Every intent detection result must have confidence strictly between 0 and 1.
invariants.evidence: Validated on 1,490 dataset items + holdout suite.

invariants.name: Rejection Detection Completeness
invariants.description: Zero rejection false negatives across holdout and long-horizon suites.

invariants.name: Safety Intents Override Commercial Intent
invariants.description: Inappropriate or spam utterances must never yield commercial intents.

invariants.name: Commercial False Positives Equal Zero
invariants.description: Small talk, greetings, and off-topic messages must not trigger product intents.

invariants.name: Terminal States are Absorbing
invariants.description: Terminal states (TERMINAL_EXIT, HARD_REJECT_EXIT, SILENT_EXIT, EXITING) have zero outgoing active transitions.

invariants.name: All State Transitions are in Adjacency Graph
invariants.description: No illegal or disconnected state transitions occur.

invariants.name: State Oscillation Equals Zero
invariants.description: Engine never oscillates back and forth between states without intent justification.

invariants.name: Turn Count and History Monotonic Growth
invariants.description: Turn count strictly increments by 1 per turn, history monotonically appends.
invariants.evidence: Verified across 2,940 long horizon conversation turns.

invariants.name: Post-Rejection Absolute Lock
invariants.description: Once rejection is received, promotion is locked to NO_PROMOTION unless explicit commercial intent.

invariants.name: CTA Minimum Turn Gap Enforced
invariants.description: Consecutive direct offers require at least MIN_CTA_TURN_GAP (2 turns) separation.

invariants.name: No Premature Direct Offer at Turn 1
invariants.description: Turn 1 cold visitor never receives DIRECT_OFFER unless explicit high commercial intent.

invariants.name: Respect Promotion Disabled Flag
invariants.description: When promotion is disabled in config, allowedLevel is strictly NO_PROMOTION.

invariants.name: Lead Score Strictly in [0, 100]
invariants.description: Lead score cannot be negative or exceed 100 under any condition.

invariants.name: Category Score Deduplication
invariants.description: Repeated identical intent category does not accumulate unbounded points.
invariants.evidence: Verified in rapid duplicate test (score bounded at category max).

invariants.name: Every Score Delta Has Explicit Factor & Reason
invariants.description: Every point increase/decrease is backed by a registered scoreFactor.

invariants.name: Funnel Monotonic Stage Ordering
invariants.description: Session count at Stage N >= Session count at Stage N+1.

invariants.name: Converted Sessions are Subset of Qualified
invariants.description: Every converted session must have traversed earlier pipeline stages.

invariants.name: Drop-off Rate Conservation
invariants.description: Stage Drop-off Rate + Stage Transition Rate = 100%.
invariants.evidence: Verified by mathematical formulation in funnelAnalytics.ts.

invariants.name: All Event Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC
invariants.description: Every recorded event timestamp parses into valid UTC epoch.

invariants.name: Zero Orphan Events Without Session Context
invariants.description: Every event has a valid sessionId, currentState, and leadScore.

invariants.name: Full Event Taxonomy Envelope Adherence
invariants.description: All 24 defined event names adhere strictly to the schema.
invariants.evidence: 24/24 event types validated in Step 7 & Step 8 suites.

invariants.name: Observer Causes Zero Side Effects
invariants.description: Analytics tracking never alters conversation state or prompt directives.
invariants.evidence: Zero state/intent/promotion mutations caused by tracking.

invariants.name: Zero Prompt Injection Breaches
invariants.description: Adversarial system prompt extraction attempts yield 0 secrets.

invariants.name: Zero Internal Key/Token Leakage
invariants.description: Environment variables or internal tokens never output to user.

invariants.name: Deterministic Bit-Identical Output
invariants.description: Replaying identical conversation produces 100% bit-identical SHA-256 hash.

invariants.name: Multi-User Concurrency Isolation
invariants.description: Concurrent user sessions do not cross-contaminate state or lead scores.
invariants.evidence: Validated with 100 concurrent interleaved sessions in Step 5.7 & Step 8.

invariants.name: Runtime Exception Immunity under Chaos
invariants.description: Corrupted or malformed inputs produce 0 uncaught exceptions.

invariants.name: Sub-Millisecond Engine Processing
invariants.description: p95 turn latency is well under 1.0 millisecond.

invariants.name: Normalization Invariance across Dialects & Slang
invariants.description: Colloquial and diacritics variants normalize to identical intent.

invariants.name: Objections Handled without Aggressive Selling
invariants.description: Objections trigger empathetic validation and informative clarification without forced CTA.
invariants.evidence: Verified across price, trust, performance, and competitor objection cases.
